name: nextpad-web
description: Editor- und Zeichenbrett-Bundle für NextPad (TipTap + Yjs, Excalidraw + Yjs), gebaut mit esbuild

scripts.build: esbuild src/editor.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/editor.js && cp src/editor.css dist/editor.css && pnpm run build:board
scripts.build:board: rm -rf dist/board && esbuild src/board.jsx --bundle --conditions=production --minify --splitting --format=esm --jsx=automatic --target=es2022 --outdir=dist/board --entry-names=[name] --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --asset-names=assets/[name]-[hash] --loader:.woff2=file --loader:.ttf=file --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --define:process.env.IS_PREACT='"false"' && cp -r node_modules/@excalidraw/excalidraw/dist/prod/fonts dist/board/fonts && rm -rf dist/board/fonts/Xiaolai && cp src/board-assets.js dist/board/assets-path.js && node patch-board.mjs
